data.narrative:
Rigetti Computing is a public-stage quantum computing company currently valued at $4.5B. The valuation assessment draws from a peer universe of 4 same-sector, same-stage quantum computing companies: IonQ ($13.0B), D-Wave Quantum ($6.3B), Infleqtion ($1.9B), and Archer Materials ($60M).

The peer-median method, the applicable triangulation approach given available data, yields an implied valuation of $4.1B. This median reflects the full dispersion of the peer set, which ranges from $60M at the low end to $13.0B at the high end—a span indicating material heterogeneity in how the market values quantum computing platforms at comparable development and commercialization stages.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $3.5B to $4.7B, centered on the $4.1B median. Rigetti's current $4.5B valuation sits within this band, approximately 10% above the peer median. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion across the peer set and reliance on a single triangulation method; additional revenue multiple or precedent transaction analysis would strengthen confidence in this range. The valuation is sensitive to which quantum computing architecture and commercial traction profile investors view as most proximal to Rigetti's position within the sector.
